stories.headline: HUMANOID ROBOTS *HIT NASDAQ*
stories.facts: Agility Robotics debuted on the Nasdaq stock exchange, marking a major milestone as a US leader in deploying humanoid robots.
stories.caption_line: 🤖 Agility Robotics debuted on the Nasdaq stock exchange as a leading US humanoid robotics firm.
stories.image_prompt: A life-sized bipedal humanoid robot standing proudly in the foreground, engineered with metallic plating and visible hydraulic actuators. In the midground, a bustling modern stock exchange trading floor glows with monitors alongside automated industrial warehouse shelves. Holographic stock ticker lines, upward-trending financial curves, and geometric circuit schematics float in the air. Moody architectural rim lighting highlights the scene in an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette, photorealistic, no text.
stories.source_title: Agility Robotics' Nasdaq debut invites scrutiny of humanoid robot market

stories.headline: CLAUDE ACCESSES *BANK ACCOUNTS*
stories.facts: Anthropic launched Personal Finance for Claude, letting users securely link checking accounts and cards through Plaid to analyze spending.
stories.caption_line: 💳 Anthropic integrated Plaid into Claude, allowing the AI to directly analyze personal bank and credit card accounts.
stories.image_prompt: A sleek modern smartphone floating in the foreground displaying glowing transaction data streams and spending summaries. In the midground, towering glass bank skyscrapers rise against an urban evening sky alongside stacks of credit cards and a digital vault door. Holographic financial pie charts, glowing balance sheets, and encrypted connection nodes hover in mid-air. Dramatic neon backlighting casts vibrant electric-blue and warm-orange reflections, photorealistic collage aesthetic, no text.
stories.source_title: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool

stories.headline: GEMINI GENERATES *LONGER VIDEO*
stories.facts: Google DeepMind released Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, generating 15-second video clips with conversational editing while cutting pricing by 30 percent.
stories.caption_line: 🎬 Google DeepMind upgraded Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash to generate 15-second videos with conversational editing at 30% lower cost.
stories.image_prompt: A professional cinematic camera rig positioned prominently in the foreground, its glass lens catching vivid reflections. In the midground, glowing digital film strips unspool across an expansive post-production studio equipped with ultra-wide editing displays. Floating holographic video timelines, frame scrubbing sliders, and volumetric rendering particles drift through the atmosphere. The studio is illuminated by dramatic theatrical rim lights in deep electric-blue and warm-orange tones, photorealistic, no text.
stories.source_title: Google's Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash stretches AI video clips to 15 seconds and cuts pricing by 30 percent

stories.headline: AI AGENTS *FAIL REAL WORK*
stories.facts: No AI model scored above 12 percent on the GDPx benchmark testing simulated knowledge work from chip design to trading.
stories.caption_line: 📉 Frontier AI models flopped on SemiAnalysis's GDPx test, with zero agents scoring above 12% on real-world knowledge work.
stories.image_prompt: A glowing holographic processor chip positioned in the foreground surrounded by fractured digital blueprints. In the midground, a high-tech corporate office with empty ergonomic chairs and rows of financial trading terminals stands under dim ambient lighting. Floating red warning indicators, descending holographic evaluation curves, and fragmented data trees hover around the workspace. High-contrast cinematic studio lighting creates dramatic electric-blue shadows and warm-orange highlights, photorealistic, no text.
stories.source_title: No AI agent scores above 12 percent on SemiAnalysis' new real-world work benchmark

stories.headline: AIRBNB BUILDS *TRAVEL AGENT*
stories.facts: Airbnb announced plans to launch an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027 to help users plan and book trips.
stories.caption_line: ✈️ Airbnb revealed plans to roll out an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027 to help users plan and book travel.
stories.image_prompt: A glowing holographic compass and stylized digital globe hovering above a luxury passport holder in the foreground. In the midground, a picturesque cliffside seaside villa overlooks sunlit ocean waters next to sleek passenger airplanes on a runway. Floating route maps, glowing travel calendar itineraries, and luminous location pins sparkle across the space. Warm golden-hour sunset lighting blends seamlessly with crisp electric-blue and warm-orange neon tones, photorealistic collage, no text.
stories.source_title: Airbnb is working on an AI travel agent

stories.headline: DROPBOX SPENDS *$350 MILLION*
stories.facts: Dropbox acquired storage startup Tigris Data for $350 million to power DBX Agent Cloud, a storage platform for developers building AI models and agents.
stories.caption_line: 💰 Dropbox bought Tigris Data for $350 million to build storage infrastructure for developers creating AI models and agents.
stories.image_prompt: A high-performance solid-state storage drive levitating in the foreground, illuminated by pulsing fiber-optic conduits. In the midground, an immense subterranean server farm stretches into the distance, filled with towering racks of flashing mainframe units. Holographic cloud storage nodes, high-speed data transfer ribbons, and glowing currency valuation charts float above the hardware. Atmospheric haze and sharp rim lighting wash the scene in contrasting electric-blue and warm-orange glows, photorealistic, no text.
stories.source_title: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M to bolster its AI infrastructure

stories.headline: META ADDS *VOICE MODE*
stories.facts: Mark Zuckerberg announced Meta users can now hold real-time voice conversations with their Muse AI agent.
stories.caption_line: 🗣️ Meta rolled out real-time voice conversations for its Muse AI agent, CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced.
stories.image_prompt: Mark Zuckerberg depicted in a confident front-facing portrait with arms crossed, positioned on one side of the foreground. Beside him, an expressive, stylized digital avatar face emerges from a glowing tablet screen. In the midground, a modern social media production lab and an array of wearable smart glasses stand on glass counters. Luminous audio speech waveforms, holographic calling interfaces, and neural nodes illuminate the space in electric-blue and warm-orange studio light, photorealistic, no text.
stories.source_title: Muse has a voice mode now
